story: Until 2026-12-29 (32 days), options price BAJFINANCE to move about ±6.5%, roughly 1,015 to 1,155. In the past, the price ended inside the range priced this way 57% of the time.
BAJFINANCE has actually been moving about 2.44% a day this past month: on the high side for it against the past year.
Options are cheap compared with how much BAJFINANCE has actually been moving: they price 27.6% a year while the last month realised 38.7%.

Calls and puts the same distance from the price cost about the same (gap -0.3 vol points): no strong demand for either protection or upside. Puts usually cost more than this for BAJFINANCE: against the past year the gap is on the high side, so less fear is priced than usual.

oi.simple: For the 2026-12-29 expiry, the biggest pile of call positions is at 1,100 (+1.9% away) and the biggest pile of put positions is at 1,000 (-7.4%). Option sellers defend these levels, so price often slows near them, but they shift as positions change.

futures.simple: BAJFINANCE futures trade 4.2 points above the price itself. That premium works out to 4.4% a year, within its usual range for the past year.
futures.analyst: Near-month basis +4.2, annualised carry 4.4% (35th percentile of the past year; its 1-year median 5.8%). Last 5 sessions (price x OI, same contracts day to day): Short covering, Long unwinding, Long build-up, Long unwinding, Long unwinding. Build-up labels describe what happened to positions; they do not say who is right.
